subject: quantitative
format: MCQ, 4 options (أ ب ج د); comparison items use the fixed options: first value greater / second greater / equal / cannot be determined. Official GAT: 120 items in 5 sections of 24, 125 min total (≈62 s per item, derived), no calculator, easy numbers. Quantitative share: 45% scientific / 25% theoretical. Pack weights use the scientific-type percentages normalised to the quantitative part.

sources.what: Official ETEC GAT guide (الدليل الإرشادي لاختبار القدرات العامة): two test types (theoretical: sharia & business tracks; scientific: general, health, cs_eng tracks); verbal and quantitative domains with % of the whole test per type; concept list per domain; 120 MCQ items in 5 sections of 24; 2 h 05 min; paper and digital; Arabic or English; no calculator; answer options أ/ب/ج/د.

ETEC Qiyas centre page embedding the product 'اختبار القدرات العامة' (updated 2026-09-08): repeats the domain table and percentages, MCQ only, calculator banned, 2 h 05 min, 5 attempts, results valid 5 years.

unverified: sub-splits inside حساب (4 topics) and هندسة (3 topics) and the ~20% comparison-format share are Darb's allocation; ETEC publishes only the domain percentages and the concept list. 'المقارنات الكمية' is a question format in the guide's examples, not a separately weighted domain.

topics.notes: Mental arithmetic with easy numbers (no calculator): operations, order of operations, number patterns, powers and roots, integers, place value, comparing numbers, estimation, fractions and decimals. About 20% of items in the official comparison format (share unverified).

Ratio and proportion, percentage of/increase/decrease, map scale, converting currencies and units of measure; short word problems. Easy to medium. About 20% of items in the official comparison format (share unverified).
Speed-distance-time, clocks and calendars, rates and work problems as listed under 'الحركة والزمن'. Medium. About 20% of items in the official comparison format (share unverified).

Mean, median, mode, range; missing value from a mean; simple and compound probability, counting. ETEC files these under arithmetic. About 20% of items in the official comparison format (share unverified).

Parallel lines and angle pairs, triangle angle sum and types, Pythagoras and special right triangles, similar triangles. Figures 'not to scale'. About 20% of items in the official comparison format (share unverified).

Perimeter and area of quadrilaterals, polygons (interior angles), circle (circumference, area, arcs, sectors), shaded-region problems. About 20% of items in the official comparison format (share unverified).
Volume and surface area of cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone, sphere; coordinate plane (distance, midpoint, slope basics). About 20% of items in the official comparison format (share unverified).

topics.unit: الجزء الكمي · جبر (4% علمي / غير مدرج في النظري)
topics.notes: Applications of linear equations and inequalities, simplifying algebraic expressions, basic identities (e.g. difference of squares). Scientific type only; theoretical test has no algebra share. About 20% of items in the official comparison format (share unverified).

topics.unit: الجزء الكمي · تفسير البيانات (8% علمي / 4% نظري)
topics.notes: Read and compute from bar charts, pie charts, line graphs, tables and Venn diagrams; often 2-4 questions per original chart (count = questions). Medium.
